ablation: remove all historical is_liquid transition-memory state and rank only the same 7-day positive residual path-efficiency confirmation among currently eligible assets; preserve rebalance and allocation
allocation: Monday fixed slots min(0.25, 1/K); unused slots cash; strict current ineligibility exits persist until next scheduled rebalance
cash_rule: no positive qualified score means cash
contamination_notes: All prior development evidence through Frontier-O is observed. Frontier-P is repeated development research, not a fresh holdout. 2023-2024 is spent.
cost_hypothesis: weekly fixed-slot portfolios should bound turnover; exact ATR-linked ladder is frozen at 0/4/8/12%
failure_mode: historical eligibility memory adds no incremental return information beyond ordinary current eligibility plus short residual path efficiency, or identity-rotated eligibility memory performs as well
falsifier: rotate the complete eligibility-memory state across currently eligible assets on each date before pairing with each asset's own residual confirmation; preserve that date's state distribution
nearest_incumbent: V11_balanced event_lifecycle_calendar_motif; Frontier-P differs by using the full historical eligibility-persistence path, requalification gap and churn/stabilization memory rather than a simple entry/new-asset event
primitive: Quantiacs daily OHLCV and historical is_liquid only
selection: among currently liquid assets, multiply positive eligibility-hysteresis state by positive 7-day market-residual path efficiency; rank positive scores top-K with deterministic label tie breaks
selection_objective: minimum research/dev Sharpe across 0.04/0.08/0.12 ATR cost; then worst DD, lower turnover, id
source_notes: Priority-1 liquidity_transition_hysteresis frontier from configs/research_frontier.yaml. Formula frozen only after Frontier-N, Frontier-M reserve and Frontier-O development evidence was observed and canonically recorded; no Frontier-P return was observed before preregistration.
stop_rule: freeze if the no-transition ablation or eligibility-state identity rotation matches/beats the canonical parent, or if every valid base cell is below the fixed 1.0 robust-development floor; do not grid-rescue after failure
thesis: A currently eligible asset whose recent eligibility persistence has improved sharply relative to its longer eligibility history, and whose requalification has remained stable rather than churning, may be undergoing durable market-access maturation. Pairing that eligibility-memory state with orderly positive residual price assimilation may identify a distinct cross-sectional state beyond simple entry age or current liquidity.
timing: completed daily bars only; toolbox owns execution lag; eligibility state uses current membership only as the admissible universe and trailing transition history through the current completed bar; rolling state and capped run-age are causal and <=365 days
validation: 2023-2024 is SPENT_DO_NOT_MUTATE and excluded from Frontier-P selection; 2025+ and live never drive mutation
